title: Pause a graph walk before a named node
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads an inline two-node graph and runs `graph_walk` with `until` the second node and `stop: before`. The first node has succeeded; the second is ready but not executed. He continues and the second node completes. Tracks stepped graph control SG-02/06/09[^sg-until].
implementation: `RunControl(mode=until, stop=before)` on `GraphExecutor.run`; product verb `graph_walk`; optional `graph.inline` on user_story YAML.
